finding: The README of the usage add-on still tells the reader to run `init-factory --add usage` without a source checkout. A user in a separate project who follows it gets the failure that IMPL-0198 describes: the installed script finds no packages/usage/ and exits 1. The fix of IMPL-0198 added `--source /path/to/agent_factory` to the handbook page install-usage-add-on.md only, and the same commit range edited this README for the total_lines field, so the two pages now disagree. The first layer where the correction was lost is the second page that states the command. Fix: give the README command the same `--source` option and one sentence naming the source clone, as the handbook page does.
why_this_severity: The handbook page holds the working command, and the README is the secondary entry point, so the user can recover from the page (no to fails_purpose). The wrong command costs one failed run and a search.
